headerDisplay: Lamps are discovered over SSDP, so nothing here is required — every field has a working default. Add a lamp under **Devices** to name it, or to give it an alert switch; the id it answers to is printed in the log as `Received advertisement from 78cb4e`.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/WhyElEss/homebridge-yeelight-wifi#readme) for what each setting does and why the defaults are what they are.

timeout.title: Reply Timeout (ms)
timeout.description: Lamps on Wi-Fi routinely need 100-200 ms, so anything under ~1000 mostly measures the network.

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Extra attempts after a failure, each on a fresh connection. A command is never written twice to the same socket.

quota.title: Commands per minute
quota.description: The firmware allows 60 and hangs up when that is exceeded, so the default leaves a margin. Raising this is how lamps used to go deaf mid-automation.

coalesce.title: Coalescing Window (ms)
coalesce.description: Characteristic writes landing inside this window are merged into one command. Raising it merges more; lowering it makes the lamp react sooner.

interface.title: Multicast Interface
interface.description: Set a specific address when the host has several and discovery binds to the wrong one.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Per-lamp settings. Lamps not listed here still work with the platform defaults.

id.title: Device ID
id.description: The full id (0x000000001778cb4e), its last six characters (78cb4e), or the model-and-id name (bslamp3-78cb4e) — whichever you find readable. It is printed in the log.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name shown in HomeKit. Defaults to the model and id, like bslamp3-78cb4e.

hidden.title: Hide this lamp
hidden.description: Keeps the whole lamp out of HomeKit, without deleting its entry here.

blacklist.title: Hide from HomeKit
blacklist.description: Advanced, and edited in the JSON editor: the lamp capabilities to keep out of HomeKit.

oneOf.title: Colour temperature — also removes Adaptive Lighting
Moonlight mode — same as switching it off below

moonlight.title: Moonlight switch for this lamp
moonlight.description: Lamps whose firmware has a night mode — one fixed warm amber at the lowest brightness — get a switch for it, “Entrance Night Light Moonlight”, alongside the light. Turn this off for a lamp that should not have one. A lamp without the mode never gets the switch either way.

enabled.title: Alert switch for this lamp
enabled.description: Adds a switch to this lamp — “Entrance Night Light Alert”, alongside the light itself. Switching it on takes the lamp to the colour below and remembers what it was doing; switching it off puts it back exactly, Adaptive Lighting included. Whether HomeKit draws it as its own tile is a per-accessory choice in the Home app: Show as separate tiles.

hue.title: Alert Hue
hue.description: 0 red · 30 orange · 50 yellow · 120 green · 195 cyan · 240 blue · 280 purple · 320 pink

saturation.title: Alert Saturation
saturation.description: 100 is the pure colour; lower washes it out towards white.

brightness.title: Alert Brightness
brightness.description: 0 keeps whatever brightness the lamp already had, which is also one command less on the wire.

brightness.title: Brightness when switched on by hand
brightness.description: Switching this lamp on without saying anything else — the Home app, a widget, Siri — brings it up at this brightness and in white, never in a colour it was left in. 0 leaves the lamp exactly where it was left. A scene that carries its own brightness or colour is left alone.

kelvin.title: Colour temperature when switched on by hand
kelvin.description: Kelvin. Used when Adaptive Lighting is not running — while it is, the lamp wakes at the transition's current temperature instead. 0 wakes it at the last white temperature it knew. Warm white is around 2700, daylight around 5000.

layout.title: Devices
layout.description: Settings for one lamp. A lamp that is not listed here still works, on the plugin's defaults.

layout.title: Connection
layout.description: These pace the plugin inside the lamp's LAN command budget. The defaults were measured against real hardware.

layout.title: Transitions
layout.description: How long the lamp takes to fade to a new value. Waking a lamp uses set_scene, which the firmware applies without a transition.
